capabilities: Analyze the current note to suggest relevant tags
Prefer previously used tags to avoid duplicates
Generate tags for highlighted text via the command palette
Batch tag multiple files or folders from the context menu
Choose among LLM providers and custom API endpoints
extras: Supports many providers; only Ollama models run locally without an API key, others require a paid provider account.
problem: Obsidian offers no built-in way to automatically suggest tags based on a note's content and the tags already used in the vault.

relations.evidence: Optional: Configure custom API endpoint (useful for Ollama or proxies)

requires.name: Provider API key (OpenAI, Mistral, Anthropic, Google, or Groq)

summary: LLM-powered tagging plugin that analyzes the open note and previously used tags to suggest up to five existing and three new tags in one click.
